digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD Gerrit verification workflow
propositions: Ubuntu CI jobs occupy 30+ runner-minutes per Gerrit Verified run due to redundant YAML parsing (bridge cadence test reads workflow 1,440 times instead of once) and repeated Pandoc corpus subprocess invocations (3,421 total processes for dual assertion of current vs legacy converter).

Static immutable Pandoc legacy-converter fixtures plus bounded real Pandoc contract samples preserve all 884 corpus assertion classes while eliminating 883 redundant subprocesses, reducing per-test wall time without removing external boundary coverage.

Workflow-level always() predicates on full-route jobs prevent GitHub cancellation of superseded patchset runs, causing 25+ minute same-change admission delays and stale runner occupancy after replacement is created.

Post-remediation organic runs average 24m58s end-to-end (22m47s–26m14s) inside the 20-30 minute target, with no individual pytest phase exceeding 30s and Ubuntu occupancy reduced 21.1% from baseline without removing coverage or adding parallelism.
